newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 30.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The 33 firms newly approved for foreign currency B share issues have started raising money through the market with the listing of Hubei Sanonda Co earlier this month.
- A commentary criticises some listed firms for either distributing excessively high returns or no dividend at all, moves which are incompatible with their results.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China has injected too much cash into circulation in the past few years despite repeated calls for control of money supply.
- Shanghai has promulgated rules on transferring real estate, to go into effect next Monday, indicating the city's property market is moving towards maturity.
